author: Megaprojects
description:
America's aging nuclear cruise missiles need replacing. The AGM-181 LRSO programme aims to give B-52 bombers a modern standoff weapon capable of penetrating advanced Russian and Chinese defences. With combined costs exceeding $28 billion, critics including former Defence Secretary William Perry question whether America truly needs another nuclear delivery option.
